notes: Grades: high = export cancel-graph chain terminal corroborated by wavu (startup,damage) fingerprint; medium = unique attack-class graph terminal without fingerprint corroboration (16 carry a wavu_conflict flag where wavu frame data disagrees); movelist_only = wavu name/notation resolution without a moveset-export graph (Bob has no circulating export).

All 81 pool notations exist in T8 wavu data (Worker C coverage: 51 exact name+notation, 4 name-only, 26 notation-only, 0 absent). The 54 pool entries still unmapped here are graph-side gaps (mostly chain throws and requirement-gated entries), not absences: their T8 identity + frame data are proven by the movelist channel.
For all 20 notation_differs entries, the T8 wavu notation equals the WH notation; the T7 MVL notation was the outlier.
Bob IS in Tekken 8 (Season 3 DLC, 2026-08) — the older not-in-T8 premise is corrected.
